name: Faba bean, coloured flowers
description: Seed of faba bean (Vicia fabaL.) from high-tannin, coloured-flowered varieties. Other names: horse bean, field bean.

name: Oat groats
description: Oat grain (Avena sativaL.) from which the hulls have been removed.

name: Soybean protein concentrate, protein 50-60%
description: Protein concentrate obtained from defatted and ground soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.) by the separation of soluble fractions, ash and non-nitrogenous compounds.

name: Vinasse, from yeast production, protein 30 %
description: Humid byproduct of the production of bakery yeast from molasses. It should contain about 30% of crude protein (as fed, calculated as nitrogen x 6.25). It has been partly depotassified by action of ammonium sulfate.

name: Ferrous carbonate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with formula FeCO3. It occurs naturally as the mineral siderite. Other names: iron(II) carbonate, ferrous carbonate.

name: L-arginine
description: L-arginine produced by fermentation

compositions.table: Brazilian Tables 5th ed. Table 1.09 (calculated from total amino acid × standardized digestibility)

name: Ferric polyphosphate
description: Inorganic chemical compound consisting of ferric ions sequestered by polyphosphates. These products have a variable iron content. Other name: iron(III) polyphosphate.

name: Maize flour byproduct, protein 8-18%, oil 14-30%
description: Byproduct of flour or grits manufacture from maize grain (Zea maysL.), consisting of maize germs and other grain fragments.

name: Wheat middlings, durum
description: By-product of durum wheat processing. It consists principally of fragments of the outer skins and of particles of grain from which less of the endosperm has been removed than in wheat bran.

name: Triticale
description: Triticale grain (TriticumxSecale).

name: L-valine
description: L-valine obtained by fermentation from carbohydrate sources.

compositions.table: Brazilian Tables 5th ed. Table 1.09 (calculated from total amino acid × standardized digestibility)

name: Fish oil, herring
description: Oil extracted from fish of the herring family (Atlantic herringClupea harengusLinnaeus 1758 and other species).

name: Millet, pearl
description: Grain of pearl millet (Pennisetum glaucum(L.) R. Br.). Other names: candle millet, dark millet, bajra, Indian millet, horse millet, bulrush millet, cattail millet.

name: Citrus pulp, dried
description: Dried byproduct of the processing of citrus fruit (Citrusspp.) for juice production or canning. It consists principally of the pulp and can include the skin and the pips. The orange (Citrus×sinensis(L.) Osbeck) is the main cultivated species.

name: Soybean protein concentrate, protein 60-70%
description: Protein concentrate obtained from defatted and ground soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.) by the separation of soluble fractions, ash and non-nitrogenous compounds.

name: Palm kernel meal, oil 5-20%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of palm fruit kernels (Elaeis guineensisJacq. orElaeis melanococcaauct.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only.

name: Calcium selenite
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CaO3Se.

name: Jatropha oil meal, oil < 5%, dehulled, detoxified
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of dehulled jatropha seeds (kernels) (Jatropha curcasL.). This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. Jatropha meal must be detoxified to be usable.

name: Molasses, beet
description: Syrupy byproduct of sugar manufacture, obtained from the crystallisation of beet sugar (Beta vulgarisL.).

name: Wheat flour "Gruau D", durum
description: Byproduct of semolina production obtained by the processing of durum wheat grains (Triticum durumL., also known asTriticum turgidumL. subsp.durum(Desf.) Husn.). It consists principally of particles of endosperm with fine fragments of the outer skins. Gruau D is the technical name of this product in the French semolina process.

name: Monodicalcium phosphate
description: Inorganic chemical compound composed of equal proportions of dicalcium phosphate and monocalcium phosphate.

name: Alfalfa, dehydrated, protein < 16% dry matter
description: Dehydrated aerial part of alfalfa (Medicago sativaL.), containing less than 16% protein (in dry matter).

name: Zinc sulfate heptahydrate RG
description: Zinc sulfate heptahydrate is the hydrated inorganic chemical compound with the formula ZnSO4·7H2O). This product is of reagent quality.

name: Dicalcium phosphate anhydrous
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CaHPO4. It is one of the main calcium phosphates used in animal feeding.

name: Oat hulls
description: Outer envelopes of the oat grain (Avena sativaL.) and byproduct of oat processing.

name: Zinc carbonate RG
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula ZnCO3. It is a white crystalline solid or powder that is insoluble in water. This product is of reagent quality.

name: Cottonseed, whole, extruded
description: Extruded whole seed of cotton (Gossypiumspp.). Other name: full-fat cottonseed.

name: Sodium molybdate dihydrate
description: Hydrated inorganic chemical compound with the formula Na2MoO4·2H2O. It is one of the main sources of supplemental molybdenum.

name: Oats, flaked
description: Flaked or rolled oat grain (Avena sativaL.).

name: Selenium methionine
description: Methionine and selenium complex used as a source of organic selenium. These products have a variable selenium content.

name: Magnesium sulfate heptahydrate RG
description: Hydrated inorganic chemical compound (salt) with the formula MgSO4·7H2O. This product is of reagent quality. Other names: epsomite, Epsom salt. Alternative spelling: magnesium sulphate heptahydrate (UK).

name: Millet, proso
description: Grain of proso millet (Panicum miliaceumL.). Other names: common millet, broomtail millet, hog millet, white millet, broomcorn millet.

name: Monoammonium phosphate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula NH4H2PO4. Other name: ammonium dihydrogen phosphate.

name: Common vetch
description: Seed of common vetch (Vicia sativaL.), a grain legume.

name: Tallow
description: Slaughterhouse byproduct consisting of heat-treated fat trimmings from cattle and other ruminant livestock, obtained before the carcass is split.

name: Citrus pulp, fresh
description: Fresh byproduct of the processing of citrus fruit (Citrusspp.) for juice production or canning. It consists principally of the pulp and can include the skin and the pips. The orange (Citrus×sinensis(L.) Osbeck) is the main cultivated species.

name: Maize bran
description: Byproduct of flour or grits manufacture from maize grain (Zea maysL.). It consists principally of outer skins, some germ fragments, and endosperm particles. Maize bran is an extremely variable product. Other name: corn bran (USA).

name: Cobalt sulfate heptahydrate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CoSO4·7H2O, which is one of the most commonly available salts of cobalt. Alternative spelling: cobalt sulphate heptahydrate (UK). Other name: cobalt(II) sulfate heptahydrate.

name: Pea
description: Seed of pea (Pisum sativumL.). Pea is one of the main grain legumes worldwide, and some varieties are grown for animal feeding.

name: L-threonine
description: L-threonine obtained by fermentation from carbohydrate sources.

compositions.table: Brazilian Tables 5th ed. Table 1.09 (calculated from total amino acid × standardized digestibility)

name: Sunflower oil
description: Oil extracted from sunflower seeds (Helianthus annuusL.).

name: Wheat distillers grains, starch < 7%, dried
description: Byproduct of alcohol (ethanol) manufacture, obtained from the distillery of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum), consisting of spent grains and steepwater solubles in variable proportions. This process uses the whole grain without bran separation, resulting in distillers grains containing less starch (< 7% as fed) than those resulting from a process where the bran is separated before starch extraction and reintroduced at the end. Other names and alternative spellings: wheat DDGS, wheat distillers' grains, wheat distiller's grains.

name: Ca Al Fe phosphate
description: Phosphate minerals based on the phosphate anion and the elements calcium, aluminium and iron.

name: Rice bran, oil > 5%, crude fibre > 20%
description: Byproduct of the processing of rice grain (Oryza sativaL.), consisting in envelopes, germs and fragments of endosperm. This product has not been defatted and contains significant amounts of hulls. Other name: full-fat rice bran.

name: DL-methionine
description: DL-methionine produced by chemical synthesis.

compositions.table: Brazilian Tables 5th ed. Table 1.09 (calculated from total amino acid × standardized digestibility)
Brazilian Tables 5th ed. Table 1.09 (calculated from total amino acid × standardized digestibility)

name: Calcium sulfate anhydrous
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CaSO4. Alternative spelling: calcium sulphate (UK).

name: Rice bran, oil < 5%, crude fibre 5-11%
description: Byproduct of the processing of rice grain (Oryza sativaL.), consisting in envelopes, germs and fragments of endosperm. This product has been defatted. Other name: defatted rice bran.

name: Grapeseed oil meal
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of grape seeds (Vitis viniferaL.).

name: Oats
description: Oat grain (Avena sativaL.).

name: Rice hulls
description: Byproduct of the processing of rice grain (Oryza sativaL.), consisting mostly in outer grain envelopes.

name: Molasses, sugarcane
description: Syrupy byproduct of sugar manufacture, obtained from the crystallisation of cane sugar (Saccharum officinarumL.).

name: Wheat feed flour
description: Byproduct of wheat flour production obtained by the milling of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum).  It consists principally of particles of endosperm with fine fragments of the outer skins.

name: Magnesium hydroxide
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula Mg(OH)2.

name: Bananas, immature, dried
description: Dried, immature fruits of the banana tree (Musasp.). Starch is the main carbohydrate of immature bananas and is transformed into solubles sugars during ripening.

name: Rice, paddy
description: Whole rice grain (Oryza sativaL.) with the hulls included. Paddy rice is further decorticated into brown rice (elimination of the hulls), pearled (elimination of the germ and pericarp) and polished.

name: Copra meal, oil < 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained after extraction from the dried kernels (copra) of the coconut fruit (Cocos nuciferaL.). This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. Other names: copra oil meal, coconut meal, coconut oil meal.

name: Magnesium oxide, granular
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula MgO. Granular form: 25% of particles > 500µ. Other name: magnesia.

name: Alfalfa protein concentrate
description: Protein concentrate obtained by pressing the aerial part of alfalfa (Medicago sativaL.). In one commercial process, fresh alfalfa is first pressed to obtain a green juice. This juice is then heated and steamed to produce a protein coagulate. This coagulate is separated from the liquid by centrifugation, and then dried. Alfalfa protein concentrate is used for its high content in protein and pigments (caroten, xanthophylls).

name: Groundnut meal, oil < 5%, crude fibre < 9%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of groundnut seeds (Arachis hypogaeaL.). The relatively low fibre content is due to the limited amount of skins and shells. It has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. Other names: peanut meal, peanut oil meal.

name: Dolomite limestone
description: Dolomite is a sedimentary rock composed of the minerals calcite and aragonite, which are different crystal forms of calcium carbonate (CaCO3), and of up to 50% dolomite (CaMg(CO3)2).

name: Soybean meal, oil < 5%, 48% protein + oil, formaldehyde-treated
description: Formaldehyde-treated byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.), with partial reintroduction of the hulls. This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. It has been treated with formaldehyde to reduce the degradability of protein in the rumen, resulting in a higher availability of protein in the intestine. It should contain about 48% (as fed) of protein + oil.

name: Rice shorts, oil < 5%, crude fibre < 5%
description: Byproduct of the processing of rice grain (Oryza sativaL.), consisting in fragments of endosperm and germs.

name: Barley rootlets, dried
description: Dried byproduct of brewery consisting of the rootlets and germs of sprouted barley grains (Hordeum vulgareL.) obtained after cleaning the malted barley. Other name: malt culms.

name: Pea, extruded
description: Extruded seeds of pea (Pisum sativumL.).

name: Fish oil, sardine
description: Oil extracted from fish from the sardine family (Sardinaand other genera).

name: Biscuit byproduct
description: Byproduct of biscuit manufacture, consisting of broken biscuits or of biscuits unfit for human consumption. This is a highly variable product, as its composition depends on that of the original material. However, there are commercial biscuit byproducts that have been homogenized to make their composition less variable.

name: Rapeseed, whole, extruded
description: Extruded whole rapeseed (Brassica napusL.,Brassica rapaL. andBrassica junceaL., and their crosses) from varieties having a low content in erucic acid and glucosinolates ("00" in Europe, canola in North America). Other name: full-fat rapeseed, full-fat canola seed.

name: Olive pulp, oil < 10%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of olive fruits (Olea europaeaL.). This product does not contain pits. It has a relatively low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure, possibly followed by solvent extraction.

name: Soybean, whole, flaked
description: Flaked or rolled soybean seed (Glycine max(L.) Merr.). Other name: flaked full-fat soybean.

name: Magnesium acetate
description: Organic chemical compound with the formula Mg(C2H3O2)2in anhydrous form. The hydrated form magnesium acetate tetrahydrate has the chemical formula Mg(CH3CO2)2·4H2O.

name: Potassium iodide
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula KI, widely used as medication and dietary supplement.

name: Vinasse, from yeast production, protein 40%
description: Humid byproduct of the production of bakery yeast from molasses. It should contain about 40% of crude protein (as fed, calculated as nitrogen x 6.25). It has been partly depotassified by action of ammonium sulfate.

name: Lard
description: Slaughterhouse byproduct consisting of rendered fat from pigs (Sus scrofaL.).

name: Fish solubles, condensed, fat
description: Concentrated fish soluble proteins obtained by enzymatic hydrolysis, filtration, concentration and dehydration of whole fish or filleting waste, containing more than 15% fat (as fed). Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Carob pod meal
description: Byproduct of the extraction of mannogalactan from carob seeds (Ceratonia siliquaL.), consisting of dried and ground carob pods.

name: Feather meal
description: Animal byproduct obtained by hydrolysing, drying and grinding poultry feathers. Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Selenium yeast
description: Selenium yeast is produced by fermentingSaccharomyces cerevisiaeyeast in a selenium-rich media. It is a source of food and feed form selenium. These products have a variable selenium content.

name: Canola meal, oil < 5%
description: By-product of the manufacture of rapeseed oil, obtained by solvent extraction of rapeseeds of Canola type.

name: Whey, dehydrated, with added fat 4-15%
description: Dried byproduct of the manufacturing of cheese, non skimmed or to which milk fat has been reincorporated up to a content of 4-15% (as fed). Whey is the liquid that separates from the curd.

name: Sunflower meal, oil 5-20%, dehulled
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of dehulled or partially dehulled sunflower seeds (Helianthus annuusL.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only.

name: Apple pomace, dried
description: Dried byproduct of apple juice or cider manufacture obtained by pressing apples (Malus communisPoir.). Apple pomace contains the peels, pulp and seeds.

name: Tomato pulp, dehydrated
description: Dried byproduct of the processing of tomato fruits (Solanum lycopersicumKarst.) for juice extraction or canning, consisting of the peels and the fruit pulp.

name: Copper sulfate
description: Copper(II) sulfate, also known as cupric sulfate, or copper sulphate, is the inorganic compound with the chemical formula CuSO4·nH2O, where n can range from 0 to 5. Copper(I) sulfate (Cu2SO4) is unstable and not used.

name: Wheat middlings (average)
description: Byproduct of wheat flour production obtained by the milling of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum). It consists principally of fragments of the outer skins and of particles of grain containing variable amounts of endosperm. Wheat middlings are often mixtures of different types of milling offal. They are typically richer in starch and less coarse than wheat bran, and poorer in starch and coarser than wheat feed flour. The composition and nutritive values are provided for "average" wheat middlings representing the whole range of starch content.

name: Mealworm larvae, dried
description: Dried larvae of mealworm (Tenebrio molitorLinnaeus 1758), a beetle insect. Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Milk powder, whole
description: Dried whole milk.

name: Calcium magnesium phosphate
description: Chemical complex of monodicalcium phosphate and magnesium phosphate with the formula (Ca, Mg)PO4·nH2O

name: Sodium iodide
description: Inorganic chemical compound (salt) with the formula NaI.

name: Wheat gluten feed, type 30% starch
description: Byproduct of the manufacture of starch obtained from wheat grains (Triticumspp.) by wet milling. It is composed of bran and gluten, to which steeping liquor and germs may be added. This product contains about 30% starch (as fed).

name: Manganese chloride dihydrate
description: Hydrated inorganic chemical compound with the formula MnCl2·2H2O. Other name: manganese(II) chloride dihydrate.

name: Monosodium phosphate hydrate FG
description: Hydrated inorganic chemical compound with the formula NaH2PO4·nH2O. This product is of feed grade quality.

name: Ammonium ferric citrate
description: Organic chemical compound with the formula (NH4)5(Fe(C6H4O7)2). It is used in animal feeds as an anticaking agent. Other name: ammonium iron(III) citrate.

name: Sunflower hulls
description: Byproduct of the processing of sunflower seeds (Helianthus annuusL.) for the manufacture of sunflower oil and other sunflower-based products, consisting of the outer envelopes obtained after the dehulling step of the process.

name: Olive oil cake, with pits, oil < 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of olive fruits (Olea europaeaL.). This product contains pits. It has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction.

name: Copper acetate
description: Organic chemical compound with the formula Cu(OAc)2where (OAc) is acetate (CH3CO2-). Other names: copper(II) acetate, cupric acetate.

name: Linseed, whole
description: Whole linseed (Linum usitatissimumL.). Other names: full-fat linseed, full-fat flaxseed

name: Sodium selenate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula Na2SeO4.

name: Magnesium phosphate
description: Inorganic chemical compound consisting of monobasic (Mg(H2PO4)2) and/or dibasic (MgHPO4) and/or tribasic magnesium phosphate (Mg3(PO4)2), in hydrate or anhydrous forms.

name: Ferric citrate
description: Organic chemical compound consisting of one atom of iron (Fe3+) and one citrate anion. This product has a variable iron content. Other name: ferric citrate, iron(III) citrate.

name: Cottonseed meal, oil < 5%, crude fibre < 15%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of dehulled cotton seeds (Gossypiumspp.). This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction.

name: Lupin, white, extruded
description: Extruded seed of white lupin (Lupinus albusL.). White lupin is a white-flowered grain legume cultivated for its seeds for animal feed and human consumption.

name: Sodium selenite
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula Na2SeO3.

name: Rapeseed, whole
description: Whole rapeseed (Brassica napusL.,Brassica rapaL. andBrassica junceaL., and their crosses) from varieties having a low content in erucic acid and glucosinolates ("00" in Europe, canola in North America). Other name: full-fat rapeseed, full-fat canola seed.

name: Soybean hulls
description: Byproduct of the processing of soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.) for the manufacture of soybean oil and other soy-based products, consisting of the outer envelopes obtained after the dehulling step of the process.

name: Cottonseed meal, oil < 5%, crude fibre 15-20%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of partially dehulled cotton seeds (Gossypiumspp.). This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction.

name: Chicory pulp, dehydrated
description: Byproduct of the extraction of fructose and inuline from chicory roots (Cichorium intybusL.).

name: Diammonium phosphate
description: Inorganic chemical compound and water-soluble ammonium phosphate salt with the formula (NH4)2HPO4. Other name: diammonium hydrogen phosphate.

name: Wheat, soft
description: Grain of soft wheat (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum).

name: Copra meal, oil 5-20%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained after extraction from the dried kernels (copra) of the coconut fruit (Cocos nuciferaL.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only. Other names: coconut meal, coconut oil meal.

name: Corn gluten meal
description: Byproduct of the manufacture of starch from maize grain (Zea maysL.) by wet milling. It consists principally of gluten obtained during the separation of starch. Corn gluten meal is a protein-rich feed (about 60%) and is a different product from corn gluten feed (about 20% protein). Other names: maize gluten meal, corn gluten, maize gluten.

name: Zinc chloride
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula ZnCl2.

name: Olive pulp, oil > 10%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of olive fruits (Olea europaeaL.). This product does not contain pits. It has a relatively high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only.

name: Pea protein concentrate
description: Protein fraction of the pea seed (Pisum sativumL.), extracted by a wet process.

name: Ferric sodium pyrophosphate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula FeNaO7P2. Other name: iron(III) sodium pyrophosphate.

name: Monocalcium phosphate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CaH4(PO4)2in anhydrous form or CaH4(PO4)2·H2O in hydrated form.

name: Poultry fat
description: Slaughterhouse byproduct consisting of fat rendered from poultry processing.

name: Grape pomace, dried
description: Dried byproduct of winery or grape juice manufacture obtained from the pressure of grapes (Vitis viniferaL.). Grape pomace typically contains the pulp, skins, seeds (pips) and sometimes the branches. Grape pomace without the seeds and branches is often called grape marc or grape pulp, but those terms are also used as synonyms.

name: Tricalcium phosphate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the chemical formula Ca3(PO4)2. Other name: tribasic calcium phosphate.

name: Pentacalcium orthoperiodate
description: Inorganic chemical compound (salt) with the formula Ca5(IO6)2.

name: Wheat feed flour, durum
description: Byproduct of wheat flour or semolina production obtained by the milling of durum wheat grains (Triticum durumL., also known asTriticum turgidumL. subsp.durum(Desf.) Husn.). It consists principally of particles of endosperm with fine fragments of the outer skins.

name: Manganese proteinate
description: Organic chemical compound that consists of manganese chelated with short-chain peptides.

name: Maize
description: Maize grain (Zea maysL.). Other name: corn (USA).

name: Disodium phosphate hydrate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula Na2HPO4·nH2O.

name: Cowpea seed
description: Seed of cowpea (Vigna unguiculata(L.) Walp.). Cowpea is a grain legume popular as human food in Africa and in some regions of Asia and the Americas. Other names: black-eyed pea, black-eyed bean, asparagus bean.

name: Sunflower seed, whole
description: Whole sunflower seed (Helianthus annuusL.). Other name: full fat sunflower seed.

name: Copra oil
description: Oil extracted from the dried kernels (copra) of the coconut fruit (Cocos nuciferaL.). Other name: coconut oil.

name: Wheat middlings, starch < 20%
description: Byproduct of wheat flour production obtained by the milling of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum). It consists principally of fragments of the outer skins and of particles of grain containing variable amounts of endosperm. Wheat middlings are often mixtures of different types of milling offal. They are typically richer in starch and less coarse than wheat bran, and poorer in starch and coarser than wheat feed flour. The composition and nutritive values are provided for wheat middlings containing less than 20% starch (as fed).

name: Copper citrate
description: Organic chemical compound with the formula Cu3(C6H5O7)2. Other name: copper(II) citrate.

name: Maize flour byproduct, protein 8-18%, oil 5-14%
description: Byproduct of flour or grits manufacture from maize grain (Zea maysL.), consisting of maize germs and other grain fragments.

name: Groundnut meal, oil < 5%, crude fibre > 9%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of groundnut seeds (Arachis hypogaeaL.). The relatively high fibre content is due to the presence of skins and shells. It has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. Other names: peanut meal, peanut oil meal.

name: Soybean meal, oil < 5%, 50% protein + oil
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.), without reintroduction of the hulls. This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. It should contain about 50% (as fed) of protein + oil.

name: Wheat middlings, starch 30-40%
description: Byproduct of wheat flour production obtained by the milling of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum). It consists principally of fragments of the outer skins and of particles of grain containing variable amounts of endosperm. Wheat middlings are often mixtures of different types of milling offal. They are typically richer in starch and less coarse than wheat bran, and poorer in starch and coarser than wheat feed flour. The composition and nutritive values are provided for wheat middlings containing between 30% and 40% of starch (as fed).

name: Cassava, starch 70-74%
description: Dried cassava roots (Manihot esculentaCrantz), containing 70-74% starch (as fed). Cassava roots are usually provided as chips, pellets or meal (ground chips).

name: Grass, dehydrated
description: Dehydrated grass from undetermined species.

name: Faba bean, coloured flowers, extruded
description: Extruded seed of faba bean (Vicia fabaL.) from high-tannin, coloured-flowered varieties. Other names: horse bean, field bean.

name: Maize germs
description: Dehydrated maize germs (Zea maysL.). Maize germs contain usually more than 30% oil (as fed). Other name: corn germs (USA).

name: Wheat bran from starch production
description: Byproduct of wheat starch production obtained by the wet milling of wheat grains (Triticum aestivum L., also known as Triticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum). It consists principally of fragments of the outer skins and of particles of grain from which the greater part of the endosperm has been removed.

name: Mustard bran
description: Byproduct of mustard manufacture obtained from the processing of the seeds of mustard (Sinapis alba L.,Brassica juncea(L.) Czern.,Brassica nigraL.), consisting of seed hulls and other seed fractions.

name: Fodder beet, raw
description: Whole fresh root of beet (Beta vulgarisL.) of fodder varieties.

name: Potato pulp, dried
description: Dried byproduct of the processing (particularly starch manufacture) of potato tubers (Solanum tuberosumL.).

name: Wheat bran
description: Byproduct of wheat flour production obtained by the milling of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum). It consists principally of fragments of the outer skins and of particles of grain from which the greater part of the endosperm has been removed.

name: Processed animal proteins, poultry, protein > 70%
description: Slaugherhouse byproduct obtained from healthy poultry slaughtered for human consumption. The product is ground, sterilized by cooking, and dried. The product must be substantially free of feathers. Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Cocoa hulls
description: Hulls of cocoa beans (Theobroma cacaoL.) and the byproduct of the dehulling step in the extraction of cocoa butter. Cocoa hulls are different from cocoa husks, which are the empty pods resulting from the removal of the beans. Other name: cocoa shells.

name: Whey permeate
description: Dried byproduct of ultrafiltration of whey, consisting of low-molecular weight compounds, particularly lactose and minerals. It also includes non-protein nitrogen compounds and vitamins.

name: Liquid potato feed
description: Liquid byproduct of potato (Solanum tuberosumL.) processing, consisting of peels and discarded potato pieces.

name: Ferrous chloride
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula FeCl2. Other names: iron(II) chloride, ferrous chloride.

name: Maize distillers grains and solubles, oil < 6 %, dried
description: Dried byproduct of alcohol (beverages) manufacture, obtained from the distillery of maize grains (Zea maysL.), consisting of spent grains and steepwater solubles in variable proportions. This product contains less residual oil than regular maize distillers. Other names and alternative spellings: dried distillers grains with solubles, maize DDGS, corn DDGS, maize distillers' grains, maize distiller's grains, corn distillers.

name: Calcium chloride dihydrate
description: Hydrated inorganic chemical compound and common form of calcium chloride with the formula CaCl2·2H2O.

name: Fish solubles, condensed, defatted
description: Concentrated fish soluble proteins obtained by enzymatic hydrolysis, filtration, concentration and dehydration of whole fish or filleting waste, containing less than 15% fat (as fed). Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Fish oil, rockfish
description: Oil extracted from fish of the rockfish family (Sebastesspp.).

name: Copper chloride tribasic
description: Dicopper chloride trihydroxide is the chemical compound with the formula Cu2(OH)3Cl. It is often referred to as tribasic copper chloride (TBCC), copper trihydroxyl chloride or copper hydroxychloride.

name: Processed animal proteins, poultry, protein 60-70%
description: Slaugherhouse byproduct obtained from healthy poultry slaughtered for human consumption. The product is ground, sterilized by cooking, and dried. The product must be substantially free of feathers. Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Cottonseed meal, oil 5-20%, crude fibre 15-20%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of partially dehulled cotton seeds (Gossypiumspp.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only.

name: Cottonseed hulls
description: Hulls of cotton seeds (Gossypiumspp.), a byproduct of the dehulling step in cotton seed processing.

name: Rice bran, oil < 5%, crude fibre > 20%
description: Byproduct of the processing of rice grain (Oryza sativaL.), consisting in envelopes, germs and fragments of endosperm. This product has been defatted and contains significant amounts of hulls. Other name: defatted rice bran.

name: Sodium sulfate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with formula Na2SO4. Alternative spelling: sodium sulphate (UK).

name: Soybean meal, oil < 5%, 48% protein + oil
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.), with partial reintroduction of the hulls. This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. It should contain about 48% (as fed) of protein + oil.

name: Sunflower meal, oil < 5%, non dehulled
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of whole (non-dehulled) sunflower seeds (Helianthus annuusL.). This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction.

name: Whey powder, acid
description: Dried byproduct of the manufacturing of soft or fresh cheese. Whey is the liquid that separates from the curd.

name: Sweet potato, dried
description: Dried sweet potato tuber (Ipomea batatas(L.) Lam.).

name: Cobalt carbonate FG
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CoCO3. This product is of feed grade quality. Other name: cobalt(II) carbonate.

name: Processed animal proteins, poultry, protein 45-60%
description: Slaugherhouse byproduct obtained from healthy poultry slaughtered for human consumption. The product is ground, sterilized by cooking, and dried. The product must be substantially free of feathers. Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Alfalfa, dehydrated, protein 16-18% dry matter
description: Dehydrated aerial part of alfalfa (Medicago sativaL.), containing between 16% and 18% protein (in dry matter).

name: Zinc metal
description: Zinc (Zn) in metallic form.

name: Maize flour, crude fibre < 2%
description: Maize flour (Zea maysL.), normally used for human consumption or for petfood.

name: Magnesium lactate
description: Organic chemical compound that is the magnesium salt of lactic acid. This mineral supplement is used as an acidity regulator and known as E329.

name: Beet pulp, dried
description: Dried byproduct of sugar manufacture, obtained after extracting the juice from sugar beet roots (Beta vulgarisL.). Other name: sugar beet pulp.

name: Linseed, whole, extruded
description: Extruded, whole linseed (Linum usitatissimumL.). Other names: full-fat linseed, full-fat flaxseed

name: Magnesium citrate
description: Organic chemical compound that is a magnesium preparation in salt form with citric acid in a 1:1 ratio. As a food additive, magnesium citrate is used to regulate acidity and is known as E345.

name: Cereal offal, crude fibre 5-14%
description: Byproduct of the processing of cereal grains of undetermined species. This product contains 5-14% (as fed) of crude fibre.

name: Sodium bicarbonate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula NaHCO3. Sodium bicarbonate is a major food additive, and is used in livestock feeding as a buffering agent.

name: Rapeseed meal, oil 5-20%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of rapeseeds (Brassica napusL.,Brassica rapaL. andBrassica junceaL., and their crosses) from varieties having a low content in erucic acid and glucosinolates ("00" in Europe, canola in North America). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only. Other names: rapeseed cake, "00" rapeseed meal, canola cake, canola meal (for North American rapeseed cultivars).

name: Wheat, durum
description: Grains of durum wheat (Triticum durumL., also known asTriticum turgidumL. subsp.durum(Desf.) Husn.). Durum wheat is normally used for the production of pasta and semolina.

name: Ammonium molybdate tetrahydrate
description: Inorganic chemical compound, normally encountered as the tetrahydrate, with the chemical formula (NH4)6Mo7O24·4H2O. It is a colorless solid. Other names: ammonium paramolybdate, ammonium molybdate.

name: Calcium iodide
description: Inorganic chemical compound and the ionic compound of calcium and iodine with the formula CaI2.

name: Wheat bran, durum
description: Byproduct of wheat flour or semolina production obtained by the milling of durum wheat grains (Triticum durumL., also known asTriticum turgidumL. subsp.durum(Desf.) Husn.). It consists principally of fragments of the outer skins and of particles of grain from which the greater part of the endosperm has been removed.

name: Soybean oil
description: Oil extracted from soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.).

name: Soybean, whole, toasted
description: Toasted (dry heated) soybean seed (Glycine max(L.) Merr.). Other name: toasted full-fat soybean.

name: Fish meal, protein 65%
description: Fish product or fishery byproduct obtained by processing whole or parts of fish. This type of fish meal contains 63-68% protein (as fed). Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Soybean meal, oil 5-20%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only.

name: Cassava, starch 66-70%
description: Dried cassava roots (Manihot esculentaCrantz), containing 66-70% starch (as fed). Cassava roots are usually provided as chips, pellets or meal (ground chips).

name: Vinasse, different origins
description: Humid product obtained by mixing the fermentation byproducts of different industries. This product has been concentrated and demineralised.

name: Maize bran, starch production
description: Byproduct of the manufacture of starch obtained from maize grain (Zea maysL.) by wet milling. It consists principally of the bran with some germ fragments.

name: Barley distillers grains, dried
description: Byproduct of alcohol (ethanol) manufacture, obtained from the distillery of barley grains (Hordeum vulgareL.), and consisting of spent grains with the soluble fraction added. Alternative spellings: barley distiller's grains, barley distillers' grains.

name: Beet pulp, pressed
description: Humid byproduct of sugar manufacture, obtained after extracting the juice from sugar beet roots (Beta vulgarisL.). The resulting solids are pressed to reduce water content down to 70-80%.

name: Vinasse, from yeast production, protein 48%
description: Humid byproduct of the production of bakery yeast from molasses. It should contain about 48% of crude protein (as fed, calculated as nitrogen x 6.25). It has been partly depotassified by action of ammonium sulfate.

name: Calcium carbonate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CaCO3. It is commonly found in rocks, notably limestone (as calcite and aragonite), and it is the main component of marine shells. Calcium carbonate is used in animal feeding as a source of calcium.

name: Brewers yeast, dried
description: Dried byproduct of brewery, consisting of yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) remaining in the fermentation vats of malt wort after removal of the fermented liquid. It is generally sold in dried form.

name: Rye
description: Rye grain (Secale cerealeL.).

name: Maize starch
description: Starch extracted from maize grain (Zea maysL.). Other name: corn starch (USA).

name: Alfalfa, dehydrated, protein 22-25% dry matter
description: Dehydrated aerial part of alfalfa (Medicago sativaL.), containing between 22% and 25% protein (in dry matter).

name: L-lysine HCl
description: Monochlorydrate of L-lysine obtained by fermentation from carbohydrate sources.

compositions.table: Brazilian Tables 5th ed. Table 1.09 (calculated from total amino acid × standardized digestibility)

name: Magnesium carbonate RG
description: Inorganic chemical compound (salt) with the formula MgCO3. This product is of reagent quality.

name: Fish oil, menhaden
description: Oil extracted from fish of the menhaden family (Brevoortiaspp.).

name: Sesame meal, oil > 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of sesame seeds (Sesamum indicumL.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only. Other name: sesame cake, sesame oil cake.

name: Soybean, whole, extruded
description: Extruded soybean seed (Glycine max(L.) Merr.). Other name: extruded full-fat soybean.

name: Cobalt oxide FG
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CoO. This product is of feed grade quality. Other names: cobalt(II) oxide, cobalt monoxide.

name: Zinc lysine
description: Lysine and zinc complex used as a source of organic zinc. These products have a variable zinc content.

name: Whey powder, sweet
description: Dried byproduct of the manufacturing of pressed cheese. Whey is the liquid that separates from the curd.

name: Blood meal
description: Dried slaughterhouse byproduct, obtained by collecting and drying the blood of slaughtered warm-blooded animals. Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Fish meal, protein 70%
description: Fish product or fishery byproduct obtained by processing whole or parts of fish. This type of fish meal contains 68-75% protein (as fed). Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Lupin, white
description: Seed of white lupin (Lupinus albusL.). White lupin is a white-flowered grain legume cultivated for its seeds for animal feed and human consumption.

name: Cobalt selenite
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CoO3Se.

name: Sunflower meal, oil < 5%, dehulled
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of dehulled or partially dehulled sunflower seeds (Helianthus annuusL.). This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction.

name: Maize, high moisture
description: Humid maize grain (Zea maysL.). This product contains 60-70% dry matter. Other name: humid corn (USA).

name: Fish oil, anchovy
description: Oil extracted from fish of the anchovy family (Engraulisand other genera).

name: Urea
description: Organic chemical compound with the chemical formula CO(NH2)2. Urea is a non-protein nitrogen compound used in ruminant feeding as a cheap source of nitrogen. Feed-grade urea contains about 42-46% nitrogen, which corresponds to 260 to 288% crude protein equivalent.

name: Copper chloride dihydrate
description: Copper(II) chloride is the chemical compound with the formula CuCl2·2H2O.

name: Calcium sulfate dihydrate
description: Hydrated inorganic chemical compound with the formula CaSO4·2H2O. Alternative spelling: calcium sulphate (UK).

name: Sorghum
description: Sorghum grain (Sorghum bicolor(L.) Moench). The nutritional values for monogastric animals correspond to low-tannin varieties.

name: Barley distillers grains, whisky production, fresh
description: Fresh byproduct of whisky manufacture, obtained from the distillery of barley grains (Hordeum vulgareL.), and consisting of spent grains.

name: Processed animal proteins, pig
description: Slaugherhouse byproduct obtained from healthy pigs slaughtered for human consumption. The product is ground, sterilized by cooking, and dried. Note:check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Alfalfa, dehydrated, protein 19-22% dry matter
description: Dehydrated aerial part of alfalfa (Medicago sativaL.), containing between 19% and 22% protein (in dry matter).

name: Wheat straw
description: Byproduct of the harvesting of wheat grains (Triticumspp.) consisting of the dry stalks of the wheat plant.

name: Soybean molasses
description: Syrupy byproduct of the manufacture of protein concentrate obtained by aqueous alcohol extraction of soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.).

name: Whey, dried, with added fat 15-30%
description: Dried byproduct of the manufacturing of cheese, to which milk fat has been reincorporated up to a content of 15-30% (as fed). Whey is the liquid that separates from the curd.

name: Ferric phosphate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula FePO4. Other names: iron(III) phosphate, ferric phosphate.

name: Rice shorts, oil > 5%, crude fibre < 5%
description: Byproduct of the processing of rice grain (Oryza sativaL.), consisting in fragments of endosperm and germs. This product has not been defatted.

name: Zinc oxide
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula ZnO.

name: Manganese methionine
description: Organic chemical compound consisting of a complex of methionine and manganese used as a source of organic manganese. These products have a variable manganese content.

name: Milk powder, skimmed
description: Dried skimmed milk.

name: Cod liver oil
description: Oil extracted from the liver of cod fish (Gadusspp.). It has higher concentrations in vitamin D and A than regular fish oil.

name: Lupin, blue
description: Seed of blue lupin (Lupinus angustifoliusL.). Blue lupin is a blue-flowered grain legume cultivated for its seeds for animal feed and human consumption. Other names: narrowleaf lupin, narrow-leaved lupin.

name: Sodium-calcium-magnesium phosphate
description: Inorganic chemical complex of dicalcium phosphate, dimagnesium phosphate and disodium phosphate with the formula (Na, Ca, Mg) PO4·nH2O.

name: Wheat gluten feed, type 20% starch
description: Byproduct of the manufacture of starch obtained from wheat grains (Triticumspp.) by wet milling. It is composed of bran and gluten, to which steeping liquor and germs may be added. This product contains about 20% starch (as fed).

name: Manganese chloride tetrahydrate
description: Hydrated inorganic chemical compound with the formula MnCl2·4H2O. It is the most common form of manganese(II) chloride. Other name: manganese(II) chloride tetrahydrate.

name: Rice, polished, broken
description: Byproduct of the polishing process in the manufacture of polished rice (Oryza sativaL.), consisting of small or broken grains.

name: Magnesium sulfate monohydrate RG
description: Hydrated inorganic chemical compound (salt) with the formula MgSO4·H2O. This product is of reagent quality. Other name: kieserite. Alternative spelling: magnesium sulphate monohydrate (UK).

name: Cocoa meal, oil < 5%
description: Byproduct of the manufacture of cocoa butter (Theobroma cacaoL.), obtained by complete extraction of cocoa beans.

name: Maize flour, crude fibre 2-10%
description: Byproduct of flour or grits manufacture from maize grain (Zea mays L.), consisting principally of particles of endosperm with fragments of germs and outer skins.

name: Black soldier fly larvae, fat > 20%, dried
description: Larvae of black soldier fly (Hermetia illucensLinnaeus 1758), not defatted, dehydrated. Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Black soldier fly larvae, fat < 20%, dried
description: Larvae of black soldier fly (Hermetia illucensLinnaeus 1758), defatted or partially defatted, dehydrated. Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Alfalfa, dehydrated, protein 17-19% dry matter
description: Dehydrated aerial part of alfalfa (Medicago sativaL.), containing between 17% and 19% protein (in dry matter).

name: Maize, flaked
description: Flaked or rolled maize grain (Zea maysL.). Other name: flaked corn, rolled corn (USA).

name: L-tryptophan
description: L-tryptophan obtained by fermentation from carbohydrate sources.

compositions.table: Brazilian Tables 5th ed. Table 1.09 (calculated from total amino acid × standardized digestibility)

name: Molybdenum metal
description: Molybdenum (Mo) in metallic form.

name: Rice bran, oil > 5%, crude fibre 11-20%
description: Byproduct of the processing of rice grain (Oryza sativaL.), consisting in envelopes, germs and fragments of endosperm. This product has not been defatted. Other name: full-fat rice bran.

name: Cassava pulp, dried
description: Dried cassava pulp is a dried by-product of the extraction of starch from cassava roots (Manihot esculentaCrantz).  This is a highly variable product.

name: Seashells, ground
description: Ground shells of marine molluscs, such as oysters. Seashells are used in animal feeding as a source of calcium carbonate.

name: Potato tuber, dried
description: Dried whole potato tuber (Solanum tuberosumL.). These are cull potatoes from potato production and potato processing industries.

name: Vinasse, from the production of glutamic acid
description: Humid byproduct of the production of glutamic acid obtained after fermentation of organic substances, particularly molasses. This product has been concentrated and demineralised.

name: Linseed meal, oil > 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of linseeds (Linum usitatissimumL.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only. Other names: linseed cake, linseed oil cake, linseed oilcake, flaxseed meal, flaxseed oil meal, flaxseed oilmeal.

name: Zinc methionine
description: Methionine and zinc complex used as a source of organic zinc. These products have a variable zinc content.

name: Fish meal, protein 62%
description: Fish product or fishery byproduct obtained by processing whole or parts of fish. This type of fish meal contains 58-63% protein (as fed). Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Maize germ meal, oil 5-20%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture, obtained by extraction of maize germs (Zea maysL.), consisting of spent germs to which parts of the endosperm and outer skins may still adhere. This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only. Other name: corn germ meal (USA).

name: Maize, extruded
description: Extruded maize grain (Zea maysL.). Other name: extruded corn (USA).

name: Ferric chloride
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula FeCl3. Other names: iron(III) chloride, ferric chloride.

name: Soybean meal, oil < 5%, 48% protein + oil, extruded
description: Extuded byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.), with partial reintroduction of the hulls. This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. It should contain about 46% (as fed) of protein + oil.

name: Alfalfa, dehydrated, protein > 25% dry matter
description: Dehydrated aerial part of alfalfa (Medicago sativaL.) containing more than 25% protein (in dry matter).

name: Manganese oxide MnO2
description: Inorganic compound with the formula MnO2. Other names: manganese(IV) oxide, manganese dioxide.

name: Manganese oxide MnO
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula MnO. Other name: manganese(II) oxide.

name: Manganese oxide MnO-Mn2O3
description: Inorganic chemical compound consistinf of a mixture of manganese(II) oxide MnO and manganese(IV) oxide Mn2O3.

name: Manganese sulfate monohydrate
description: Manganese(II) sulfate monohydrate, or manganese sulfate monohydrate, is the hydrated inorganic chemical compound (salt) with the formula MnSO4·H2O. Alternative spellings: Manganese(II) sulphate monohydrate, manganese sulphate monohydrate (UK).

name: Ferrous sulfate monohydrate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula FeSO4·H2O. Alternative spellings: Iron(II) sulphate monohydrate, ferrous sulphate monohydrate (UK). Other names: iron(II) sulfate monohydrate, ferrous sulfate monohydrate.

name: Palm oil
description: Oil extracted from the pulp (mesocarp) of palm fruits (Elaeis guineensisJacq. orElaeis melanococcaauct.). Palm oil is a different product from palm kernel oil, which is extracted from the fruit kernels.

name: Chickpea, kabuli type
description: Seeds of chickpea (Cicer arietinumL.) from kabuli varieties. Kabuli (also called garbanzo) chickpeas are tan-coated and are grown primarily in the Mediterranean area and in South America. They contain less crude fibre than the smaller and dark-coated desi types grown in the Indian subcontinent.

name: Monosodium phosphate hydrate
description: Hydrated inorganic chemical compound with the formula NaH2PO4·nH2O.

name: Maize flour byproduct, protein 8-18%, oil <5%
description: Byproduct of flour or grits manufacture from maize grain (Zea maysL.), consisting of grain fragments and some maize germs.

name: Grape seeds
description: Dried byproduct of wine or grape juice manufacture obtained from the pressure of grapes (Vitis viniferaL.). Grape seeds result from the removal of the seeds in certain processes.

name: Manganese carbonate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula MnCO3.

name: Groundnut meal, oil 5-20%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of groundnut seeds (Arachis hypogaeaL.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only. Other names: groundnut cake, groundnut oil cake, peanut cake, peanut oil cake, peanut meal, peanut oil meal.

name: Methionine Hydroxy Analog MHA
description: Organic chemical compound used in animal feeding as an analogue of DL-methionine. Full name: DL-2-hydroxy-(4-methylthio) butanoic acid.

name: Maize distillers grains with solubles, ethanol production, dried
description: Byproduct of alcohol (ethanol) manufacture, obtained from the distillery of maize grains (Zea maysL.), consisting of spent grains and steepwater solubles in variable proportions. Other names and alternative spellings: dried distillers grains with solubles, maize DDGS, corn DDGS, maize distillers' grains, maize distiller's grains, corn distillers.

name: Cottonseed, whole
description: Whole seed of cotton (Gossypiumspp.). Other name: full-fat cottonseed.

name: Linseed meal, oil < 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of linseeds (Linum usitatissimumL.). This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. Other names: flaxseed meal, flaxseed oil meal.

name: Soybean protein concentrate, protein 70-90%
description: Protein concentrate obtained from defatted and ground soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.) by the separation of soluble fractions, ash and non-nitrogenous compounds. Soybean concentrates with particularly high protein content are sometimes called soybean isolates or soy isolates.

name: Wheat gluten
description: Byproduct of the manufacture of starch from wheat grains (Triticumspp.) by wet milling. It consists principally of gluten obtained during the separation of starch. Wheat gluten is a protein-rich product (about 80% crude protein as fed) mostly used for human food, with some applications for animal feeding.

name: Magnesium oxide
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula MgO. Other name: magnesia.

name: Buckwheat hulls
description: Hulls of buckwheat seeds (Fagopyrum esculentumL.). This is a byproduct of the processing of buckwheat for milling or other purposes.

name: Magnesium oxide, powder
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula MgO. Other name: magnesia.

name: Monosodium phosphate anhydrous FG
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula NaH2PO4. This product is of feed grade quality.

name: Molybdenum trioxide
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula MoO3.

name: Wheat distillers grains, starch > 7%, dried
description: Byproduct of alcohol (ethanol) manufacture, obtained from the distillery of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum), consisting of spent grains and steepwater solubles in variable proportions. This process begins with the separation of the bran, which is reintroduced in the byproduct after starch extraction, resulting in distillers grains containing more starch (> 7% as fed) than those resulting from a process without preliminary bran separation. Other names and alternative spellings: wheat DDGS, wheat distillers' grains, wheat distiller's grains.

name: Copper methionine
description: Methionine and copper complex used as a source of organic copper. These products have a variable copper content.

name: Brewers grains, dried
description: Dried byproduct of brewery, consisting of the spent grains left after the production of beer and other malt products (malt extracts and malt vinegar). Though beer can be made with other grains, such as sorghum or rice, the values indicated below are only for brewers grains obtained from barley (Hordeum vulgareL.). Alternative spellings: brewer's grains, brewers' grains.

name: Copper oxide
description: Copper(II) oxide or cupric oxide is the inorganic compound with the formula CuO.

name: Lentils
description: Seeds of lentil (Lens esculentaMoench). Lentil is a major grain legume used around the world as human food.

name: Copper proteinate
description: Complex chemical compound where copper is chelated with short-chain peptides. These products have a variable copper content.

name: Limestone
description: Sedimentary rock, composed mainly of the minerals calcite and aragonite, which are different crystal forms of calcium carbonate (CaCO3). Limestone is used in animal feeding as a source of calcium.

name: Disodium phosphate anhydrous
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula Na2HPO4. Other name: sodium hydrogen phosphate.

name: Fish oil, salmon
description: Oil extracted from fish from the salmon family (Oncorhynchusspp. andSalmo salarLinnaeus 1758).

name: Common bean
description: Seed of common bean (Phaseolus vulgarisL.). Common beans are normally used for human food but can occasionally be fed to livestock. The common bean is known under many names (kidney bean, French bean, navy bean...), depending on the variety.

name: Olive oil cake, with pits, oil > 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of olive fruits (Olea europaeaL.). This product contains pits. It has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only.

name: Wheat middlings, starch 20-30%
description: Byproduct of wheat flour production obtained by the milling of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum). It consists principally of fragments of the outer skins and of particles of grain containing variable amounts of endosperm. Wheat middlings are often mixtures of different types of milling offal. They are typically richer in starch and less coarse than wheat bran, and poorer in starch and coarser than wheat feed flour. The composition and nutritive values are provided for wheat middlings containing between 20% and 30% of starch (as fed).

name: Copper lysine
description: Lysine and copper complex used as a source of organic copper. These products have a variable copper content.

name: Palm kernel meal, oil < 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of palm fruit kernels (Elaeis guineensisJacq. orElaeis melanococcaauct.). This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction.

name: Ferric pyrophosphate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula Fe4(P2O7)3. Other name: iron(III) pyrophosphate.

name: Grape pulp, dried
description: Dried byproduct of winery or grape juice manufacture obtained from the pressure of grapes (Vitis viniferaL.). Grape pulp typically contains the pulp and skins, but not the seeds (pips) or the branches. It is sometimes synonym of grape marc or grape pomace, though the latter product often contains also the seeds and branches.

name: Zinc carbonate FG
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula ZnCO3. It is a white crystalline solid or powder that is insoluble in water. This product is of feed grade quality.

name: Calcium iodate anhydrous
description: Inorganic chemical compound composed of calcium and iodate anion with the formula Ca(IO3)2.

name: Cereal offal, crude fibre > 14%
description: Byproduct of the processing of cereal grains of undetermined species. This product contains more than 14% (as fed) of crude fibre.

name: Fish oil, capelin
description: Oil extracted from the capelin fish (Mallotus villosusO. F. Müller 1776).

name: Sheanut oil meal, oil > 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of sheanut seeds (Vitellaria paradoxaC. F. Gaertn.) for the production of sheanut butter. This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only.

name: Rice, brown
description: Unpolished rice grain (Oryza sativaL.) without the hulls but with the outer grain layers.

name: Sunflower meal, oil 5-20%, non dehulled
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of whole sunflower seeds (Helianthus annuusL.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only.

name: Corn gluten feed
description: Byproduct of the manufacture of starch obtained from maize grain (Zea maysL.) by wet milling. It is composed of bran and gluten, to which steeping liquor and germs, deoiled or not, may be added. The values below are given for dried corn gluten feed but this product is also sold in humid form. Other name: maize gluten feed.

name: Diiodosalicylic acid
description: Organic chemical compound with the formula I2C6H2(OH)CO2H. Full name: 3,5-diiodosalicylic acid.

name: L-isoleucine
description: L-isoleucine produced by fermentation

compositions.table: Brazilian Tables 5th ed. Table 1.09 (calculated from total amino acid × standardized digestibility)

name: Soybean meal, oil < 5%, 46% protein + oil
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.), with partial reintroduction of the hulls. This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. It should contain about 46% (as fed) of protein + oil.

name: Wheat middlings, starch > 40%
description: Byproduct of wheat flour production obtained by the milling of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum). It consists principally of fragments of the outer skins and of particles of grain containing variable amounts of endosperm. Wheat middlings are often mixtures of different types of milling offal. They are typically richer in starch and less coarse than wheat bran, and poorer in starch and coarser than wheat feed flour. The composition and nutritive values are provided for wheat middlings containing more than 40% starch (as fed).

name: Maize germ meal, oil < 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture, obtained by extraction of maize germs (Zea maysL.), consisting of spent germs to which parts of the endosperm and outer skins may still adhere. This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. Other name: corn germ meal (USA).

name: Shrimp meal
description: Dried byproduct of the shrimp processing industry, consisting of soft tissues and shells of shrimps and prawns. Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.

name: Cottonseed meal, oil 5-20%, crude fibre < 15%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of dehulled cottonseeds (Gossypiumspp.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only.

name: Faba bean, white flowers
description: Seed of faba bean (Vicia fabaL.) from low-tannin, white-flowered varieties. Other names: horse bean, field bean.

name: Bakery byproduct
description: Byproduct of bread manufacture, consisting of bread and other bakery products unfit for human consumption.

name: Dicalcium phosphate dihydrate
description: Hydrated inorganic chemical compound with the formula CaHPO4·2H2O. It is one of the main calcium phosphates used in animal feeding.

name: Camelina oil meal, oil > 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of camelina seeds (Camelina sativaCrantz) using mechanical pressure only.

name: Rice bran, oil > 5%, crude fibre 5-11%
description: Byproduct of the processing of rice grain (Oryza sativaL.), consisting in envelopes, germs and fragments of endosperm. This product has not been defatted. Other name: full-fat rice bran.

name: Barley
description: Barley grain (Hordeum vulgareL.). This feed includes two-row and six-row barleys but not hulless ("naked") varieties.

name: Sodium chloride
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula NaCl. Other names : salt, halite.

name: Ferrous sulphate heptahydrate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula FeSO4·7H2O. Other names: iron(II) sulphate heptahydrate, ferrous sulphate heptahydrate.

name: Soybean, whole, toasted, flaked and expanded
description: Soybean seed (Glycine max(L.) Merr.) processed by mild toasting, flaking, expanding and pelleting.

name: Rapeseed meal, oil < 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of rapeseeds (Brassica napusL.,Brassica rapaL. andBrassica junceaL., and their crosses) from varieties having a low content in erucic acid and glucosinolates ("00" in Europe, canola in North America). This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. Other names: "00" rapeseed meal, canola meal (for North American rapeseed cultivars).

name: Potato protein concentrate
description: Dried byproduct of starch manufacture from potato tubers (Solanum tuberosumL.) consisting mainly of protein substances obtained after the separation of starch.

name: Phosphate, defluorinated
description: Inorganic chemical compound obtained from natural phosphates (consisting mostly of tricalcium phosphate) defluorinated by calcination.

name: Calcium chloride anhydrous
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CaCl2. It is a colorless crystalline solid at room temperature, highly soluble in water.

name: Cobalt glucoheptonate
description: Chemical compound that is a salt of colbalt used for cobalt supplementation.

name: Calcium iodate hexahydrate
description: Hydrated inorganic compound composed of calcium and iodate anion, with the formula Ca(IO3)2·6H2O.

name: Copper carbonate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula Cu2CO3(OH)2. Other names: copper carbonate, copper(II) carbonate hydroxide.

name: Monosodium phosphate anhydrous
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula NaH2PO4.

name: Rice bran, oil < 5%, crude fibre 11-20%
description: Byproduct of the processing of rice grain (Oryza sativaL.), consisting in envelopes, germs and fragments of endosperm. This product has been defatted. Other name: defatted rice bran.

name: Rapeseed oil
description: Oil extracted from rapeseeds (Brassica napusL.,Brassica rapaL. andBrassica junceaL., and their crosses) from varieties having a low content in erucic acid and glucosinolates. Other name: canola oil (for North American rapeseed varieties).

name: Rice distillers grains with solubles, protein 40-50%, dried
description: Dehydrated byproduct of rice distillation (Oryza sativa L.) for the fabrication of alcohol (ethanol), consisting of spent grains and steepwater solubles in variable proportions.

name: Ethylenediamine dihydroiodide
description: Organic chemical compound composed of ethylenediammonium dication (C2H4(NH3)22+) and iodide anions. It is a water-soluble salt used as an additive with high biovavailability to prevent iodine deficiency in animals feeds. Abbreviation: EDDI.
